name: Citation Check
description: Checks the quoted claims of a document against the pages they cite, with AgentOS's citation tooling: word for word first, then by embeddings when a model is configured

extensions.description: Checks each quoted claim of a document against the page its address names

embeddings.description: Grades a claim that is not on its page word for word with OpenAI embeddings through AgentOS

egress.description: The AgentOS egress policy the tool reads pages through: public https addresses alone, or any address

timeoutMs.description: The deadline for each page, in milliseconds

maxBytes.description: The most bytes read from a page

maxPages.description: The most distinct pages one check fetches
